pattern: IM-X01 via the tenant: the routine leak becomes an active escape of water into the flat below, out of hours, while the landlord's only reply is an emoji
notes: Event 007 is the base mutation (the landlord's thumbs-up emoji). Appended event 008 (system 'response to tenant' prompt) and event 009, the tenant's email on Wednesday 27 March 2024 at 19:42 (out of hours): the downstairs neighbour in Flat 10 reports water coming through his bathroom ceiling, the hose is still dripping with water under the tray, and she cannot find the stopcock. Active escape of water into another flat is an emergency; the ambiguous emoji no longer gates the make-safe. History truncated after event 009. Expected: tell the tenant at once how to stop the water (isolation valve on the shower supply or the main stopcock, commonly under the kitchen sink or near the meter), keep the water off electrics and warn the neighbour about his ceiling light; emergency plumber to isolate and repair tonight without waiting for the landlord; landlord told the new facts (insurance, flat below); no admission of liability to the neighbour; escalation to the on-call human.
